title: HerAgent: A Block-Level Checkpointing Harness for Coding-Agent Environment Setup
abstract: arXiv:2611.18443v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern coding agents rely on establishing executable software environments before they can perform software engineering tasks such as testing, debugging, and patch validation. Existing setup agents typically control progress at either single-command or whole-script granularity, making recovery either too local to remove polluted state or too coarse to preserve useful progress. We present HerAgent (Harness EnviRonment Setup Agent), a block-level harness for coding-agent environment setup. HerAgent's main contribution is semantic setup blocks: a single progress-control abstraction used for execution, validation, checkpointing, repair, and rollback. Evaluated against six prior agents on four environment-setup datasets, HerAgent improves setup success in every comparison, achieving the largest gains on Installamatic-Bench (52.0% to 85.0%) and SetupBench (46.3% to 70.4%). translated_title: HerAgent：面向编程智能体环境搭建的块级检查点框架
translated_abstract: 现代编程智能体在执行测试、调试和补丁验证等软件工程任务之前，需要先建立可执行的软件环境。现有的环境搭建智能体通常以单命令或整个脚本的粒度来控制进度，这使得恢复操作要么过于局部而无法清除污染状态，要么过于粗糙而无法保留有用的进展。我们提出了HerAgent（Harness EnviRonment Setup Agent），这是一个面向编程智能体环境搭建的块级框架。HerAgent的主要贡献是语义化搭建块：这是一种统一的进度控制抽象，用于执行、验证、检查点保存、修复和回滚。在四个环境搭建数据集上与六个先前智能体进行对比评估，HerAgent在所有对比中均提升了搭建成功率，在Installamatic-Bench（从52.0%提升至85.0%）和SetupBench（从46.3%提升至70.4%）上取得了最大幅度的提升。它还将搭建成本降低高达94.5%，表明块级……
tldr: HerAgent提出“语义化搭建块”这一块级进度控制抽象，将执行、验证、检查点保存、修复与回滚统一起来，在四个环境搭建数据集上全面超越六个先前智能体，成功率最高提升33个百分点且搭建成本降低高达94.5%。
en_tdlr: HerAgent introduces semantic setup blocks, a single block-level progress-control abstraction unifying execution, validation, checkpointing, repair, and rollback, outperforming six prior agents across four environment-setup datasets with up to 33-point success gains and up to 94.5% cost reduction.
